core_obligations: Get the étale neighbourhood: apply the local structure statement at the point to find an elementary etale neighbourhood such that the pullback of the module is of finite presentation near the corresponding point of the fibre (proof lines 2886-2893).
Use descent: the induced local ring map to the base change is flat and local, being a localisation of an etale ring map, hence faithfully flat (proof lines 2893-2905).
Conclude: finite presentation of the pullback at the lifted point descends to finite presentation of the stalk at the given point (proof lines 2900-2903).
proof_roadmap: Etale neighbourhood with a finitely presented pullback (proof lines 2886-2893).
Flatness and localness of the induced local ring map (proof lines 2893-2905).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a locally finitely presented morphism a finite type module flat at a point is finitely presented at that point (statement lines 2878-2884, tag 05P8-adjacent). The proof applies the local structure statement to get an etale neighbourhood on which the pullback is finitely presented near the lifted point and then descends finite presentation along the flat, hence faithfully flat, local ring map, which is a localisation of an etale ring map. The descent step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
